oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: Ledger L15, 05/10/2026: on a two-language Tracy Business wp7 site after the L01 fix, the Vietnamese About page kept a whole demo section (heading and intro naming an industrial park and five cities): 7 demo words, duplicates and unslotted lines were rewritten for the source language only. Reds 4f6bbb9bc, b1b93999a, 414a5da18, fa26ee0e9, d26f5f821, 4f546157d; fixes b9d4aff65, 7cc0c9b8e, 758a34c31, 4a04416ab, b06215e05, 10a589255; guards 18ca3d03d.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 76). Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): a second language's second and third blocks of a name, its other lines and its second chance are planned in its own language; a copy's demo block goes on silence only when its source line went in and every call of the language's plan answered; blocks never empty a page; one language's failure costs no other language's lines; an interface-only line is never taken off; more failed blocks than MAX_DROPS take none; the copies' title, description and heading are said again in their own language.

a second chance that answers but says nothing of a line takes its block off when its source counterpart was rewritten
a language with a batch of its first pass that failed removes nothing on the second chance's silence
a line the site refused in the source language keeps the other language's block too

a line that is only an interface is never taken off a copy on the second chance's silence
more blocks of one language with no honest line than MAX_DROPS is a model gone wrong: none of them goes, and it is said
the other languages' copies have their title, description and heading said again in their own language
a retry asked live counts as a call
